name: Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk.
summary: PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk operates primarily within the real estate sector, engaging in a comprehensive range of activities from property acquisition and divestiture to the leasing and management of both owned and rented assets. The company boasts a diverse portfolio of projects, including Permata Hijau Residences, Bizpark PIK 2, Soho Manhattan, The Bund, Millennial Shop Office, Manhattan Residences, Soho Wallstreet, Asia Afrika Shop Office, Millennial Houses, Petak 9 Shop Office, Little Siam Shophouse, and Menara Syariah. This firm was established on April 3, 2000, and is headquartered in Tangerang, Indonesia.
